caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown finish. The chest is rectangular, standing on four curved legs and has a decorative trim at the base and top edge. There are three columns of drawers, with each side column containing four drawers and the central column containing three drawers, totaling eleven drawers. Each drawer is fitted with a pair of ornate, yellow-gold colored handles. The uppermost drawers feature a carved fan or shell motif above them. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or features. The drawing has shading and details that give the chest a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Chest of Drawers
